template.name: Controller
Payload
template.declaration: clock y; int[0,3] pending = NORMAL; // mode captured when the request was decoded

transition.label: pending != BAD_CRC && y >= (pending == DELAYED ? DELAY_MS : 0) + TX_MIN_MS
resp_ok!

template.name: Host
template.declaration: clock z; // time since fault injection confirmed clock zr; // time since NORMAL restoration confirmed clock zn; // time in nominal

transition.label: zn >= 2 * POLL_MS && link == ONLINE
inject!
mode = FAULT_MODE, z = 0, toutInFault = 0, crcInFault = false, seqInFault = false, offlineInFault = false
